sketches.mechanism: Move semantics: a value without Copy is transferred to the first caller, and any later use of the same binding is a compile-time error.
sketches.resonance: What has been given away remains named, but the language refuses to let the name pretend it still possesses anything.

sketches.mechanism: The bottom type Nothing is a subtype of every type because an expression of that type never successfully returns.
sketches.resonance: Absence can fit any promised form, but only by never arriving there alive.

class Home

sketches.mechanism: Negation as failure: \+ Goal succeeds when Goal cannot be proven from the program.
sketches.resonance: A presence that cannot be proved becomes an absence by rule, not by truth.
